ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area (~85-90%) with high-intensity (white) features appearing as sparse, sharp pixel clusters and streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black base layer; high-contrast white linear streaks distributed across the central and medial regions of both lobes; dense white circular-to-irregular blobs concentrated at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep central V-shaped notch; visible pixel-based interior angle approximately 55 degrees with a defined vertical depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire span from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curves extending from the median notch upward and outward towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme left and right tips, consistent with barnacle colonization; smaller circular white spots scattered across the ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-intensity white linear streaks (rake marks) of varying length and thickness cutting across the black pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks and significant white calcified-looking accretions (barnacles) at the lateral lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: The concentration of white barnacle-like clusters is significantly higher at the lateral tips compared to the medial or central regions of the fluke.
